document_api_meta.title: Send IM Message
document_api_meta.env_desc: Sends a message of the selected type in the specified conversation.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: msg_type
request_body_param.desc:
Message type. The value determines the decoded JSON object required in `content`. Possible values:
- `TEXT`
- `PRODUCT_CARD`
- `TARGET_COLLABORATION_CARD`
- `FREE_SAMPLE_CARD`
- `IMAGE`
- `CRM_TEXT_WITH_IMAGE_CARD`
- `CRM_TEXT_WITH_PRODUCTS_CARD`

request_body_param.name: content
request_body_param.desc:
Message content as a JSON-serialized string. The decoded JSON object depends on `msg_type`:

- `TEXT`: `{"content": "simple text"}`. `content` is required, must not be empty, and supports up to 2,000 Unicode characters.
- `PRODUCT_CARD`: `{"product_id": "12345"}`. `product_id` is required.
- `TARGET_COLLABORATION_CARD`: `{"target_collaboration_id": "1234"}`. `target_collaboration_id` is required and is the invitation group ID.
- `FREE_SAMPLE_CARD`: `{"apply_id": "1234"}`. `apply_id` is required.
- `IMAGE`: `{"url": "https://p16-oec-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/2ca53c34ad8443e6b39f4e0153d3aed4~tplv-o3syd03w52-origin-image.image?from=1320446476", "width": 1280, "height": 720}`. `url`, `width`, and `height` are required; `width` and `height` must be integers. You can obtain `url` by calling [Upload Messages Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/upload-message-image-v2-202608).
- `CRM_TEXT_WITH_PRODUCTS_CARD`: `{"product_ids": "12345,123456", "title": "abc", "content": "abc"}`. `product_ids` is required and contains one to five comma-separated positive product IDs. `content` is required, must not be empty, and supports up to 500 Unicode characters. `title` supports up to 50 Unicode characters.
- `CRM_TEXT_WITH_IMAGE_CARD`: `{"image_url": "https://p16-oec-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/2ca53c34ad8443e6b39f4e0153d3aed4~tplv-o3syd03w52-origin-image.image?from=1320446476", "title": "abc", "content": "abc"}`. `image_url` and `content` are required. `content` must not be empty and supports up to 500 Unicode characters. `title` supports up to 50 Unicode characters.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^message_id
response_param.desc: The message ID. The `message_id` field is not always returned upon successful message submission.
